evidence.citation: “Re-run all three cases, including the two that previously passed”; “Run each case 2–3 times to account for nondeterminism and report pass rates”; and “sweep the live checkout after every run and clean any leaks.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The required work validates regression status and reproducibility while protecting cleanroom isolation and integrity. Under the supplied bar, rerunning prior passes, repeating nondeterministic cases, using fresh runners and judges, and performing post-run leak sweeps are necessary controls rather than a cost regression.
